attempts.text: MATCH (a:Issue)-[l]->(b:Issue) WHERE a<>b AND type(l) <> 'HAS_PARENT' AND exists{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)} AND exists{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)} AND [(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)|p.personKey][0] <> [(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)|q.personKey][0] RETURN count(l)

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE all(r IN rs WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL)
WITH p, rs, a, b, [n IN nodes(p)|head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS asg
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i] IS NOT NULL AND asg[i+1] IS NOT NULL AND asg[i]<>asg[i+1])
AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=size(nodes(p))
AND NOT exists{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE r2.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN nodes(p) AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey]) IS NOT NULL AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey])<>asg[0]}
AND NOT exists{(b)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE r2.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN nodes(p) AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey]) IS NOT NULL AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey])<>asg[-1]}
RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links, [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS issues

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE all(r IN rs WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL)
WITH p, rs, a, b, nodes(p) AS ns, [n IN nodes(p)|head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS asg
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i] IS NOT NULL AND asg[i+1] IS NOT NULL AND asg[i]<>asg[i+1])
AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j]))
AND NOT exists{(a)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE r2.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey]) IS NOT NULL AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey])<>asg[0]}
AND NOT exists{(b)-[r2]-(c:Issue) WHERE r2.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT c IN ns AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey]) IS NOT NULL AND head([(c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey])<>asg[-1]}
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links, [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS issues

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person) WITH count(*) AS c
MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]-(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND id(a)<id(b) AND head([(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])<>head([(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)|y.personKey]) RETURN c, count(r), count(DISTINCT a)+count(DISTINCT b)
